subject: Air freight quote to SGN
body:
Hi there,

Hope your week’s going well! Could you quote your cheapest air freight option to SGN (Ho Chi Minh City, VN)?

The shipment is laboratory glassware: 11 pieces, with a gross weight of 1558 kg and a volume of 5.04 cbm. It’ll be ready for pickup on 2026-11-24 at our site in 51154 (Bergisch Gladbach), Germany. Could you arrange the truck from our site to the departure airport and include that in the all-in price in EUR?

Please attach the offer as a PDF when you reply, as our purchasing department needs it for filing.

Thanks for your help!

Thanks a lot and have a lovely day!
Petra Hofmann
Export Desk, Hofmann Textilwerk KG
